culture-cycles.note: Bank holidays notified for the RBI Lucknow office for 2026; state government offices usually close on these days too, but the state's own gazette list can differ. Where RBI shows several festival names for one day, the label lists all of them; the one that applies here is the festival observed in this state. Dates before 5 November 2026 have passed; replace with the 2027 list when RBI publishes it. Lunar and Islamic dates move each year.

culture-and-protocol.dress_and_conduct: At the Taj Mahal: no eating or smoking inside; tobacco, liquor, food, headphones, knives, chargers, tripods and electric goods other than cameras are banned; phones off or silent; no noise inside the mausoleum; don't touch or scratch the walls. Hire only approved guides and photographers who show ID.
culture-and-protocol.sacred_or_restricted_places: Photography is banned inside the main mausoleum, and drones are banned in and around the Taj Mahal. Polluting vehicles are barred within 500 m.
culture-and-protocol.cultural_authority: Department of Tourism, Government of Uttar Pradesh (official Taj Mahal website).
culture-and-protocol.note: Taj Mahal only. Shoe covers come with the foreigner ticket. Other Uttar Pradesh sites (for example Varanasi ghats) are not covered.
